name: Golden Pothos
hook: The plant that survives everything (except overwatering).

steps.title: Low to bright indirect
steps.tip: It tolerates dim corners, but brighter light keeps the golden variegation bold.

steps.title: Water when top 5 cm is dry
steps.tip: Let the top 4–5 cm of soil dry out; droopy leaves are its signal that it's thirsty.

steps.title: Pinch for fullness
steps.tip: Trim leggy vines just above a leaf to push out new growth and keep it bushy.

steps.title: Root cuttings in water
steps.tip: Cut stems with at least one node, stand them in water in bright light, and pot up once roots form.

steps.title: Feed in spring & summer
steps.tip: Use a general houseplant fertilizer once a month from spring to early autumn.

outro: Trim, root, repeat: one pothos can fill your whole apartment.

sources.title: Clemson HGIC: How to Grow Pothos Indoors
